description: Benne Tindi in Bhayandar West is a popular South Indian eatery known for authentic, freshly prepared breakfast and snack items. We specialize in traditional benne-style dishes, including soft dosas, idlis, vadas and other Karnataka-inspired tindi favorites, served with flavorful chutneys and sambar. Our focus is on quality ingredients, rich taste and quick service, making us a go-to spot for families, office-goers and food lovers. Visit Benne Tindi for a delicious, homely South Indian food experience at affordable prices.

owner_posts.post_text:
Soft, flavorful and loaded with authentic South Indian masala, our Idli Fry is pure comfort on a plate. Fresh idlis gently tossed in aromatic spices and herbs, coated in rich masala, and served with delicious chutneys. Light yet satisfying, you can enjoy it anytime in Bhayandar.

Visit Benne Tindi today and treat yourself to this delicious Idli Fry! 🍽️

Enjoy the authentic taste of Karnataka at Benne Tindi! 🧈✨

Visit Benne Tindi today and experience the true taste of Benne Dosa! 😋

featured_reviews.name: ANIKET SALUNKHE
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an absolute gem for authentic South Indian food lovers. Everything here screams authenticity.  The must-try items are anything loaded with ghee — the Ghee Roast Benne Dosa is crisp, aromatic, and generously drenched in pure ghee, while the tatte idli loaded with ghee is soft, fluffy, and incredibly satisfying.

Rich in flavor yet very easy on the pocket, making it great value for money. Hygiene is well maintained, and you can really taste the traditional touch in every bite. Another strong recommendation is the idli with podi — simple, spicy, and perfectly balanced.

Overall, a fantastic spot for hygienic, authentic, and flavourful South Indian food. Highly recommended and definitely worth repeat visits!

We look forward to welcoming you again soon at Benne Tindi! 🙏

They serve mainly pomfret, bombil, tarli, ravas, manli and prawns fry and also ambotik and other fish curries. They also serve Chicken kheema and chicken curry and a few local vegetables. These can be accompanied by their famous rice bhakari or chapatis all made in-house. A must visit to pick food or even eat at the place if your looking for authentic village yummy food.

We visited Silverdor Club Resort on 1st May. While the property itself looks good and the general maintenance of the common areas is decent, our experience in the JADE Room (standard room) was extremely disappointing and people should know what they may be paying for.

The room was poorly maintained and far below expected standards. The bed had a spring sticking out, which kept hurting us and made it uncomfortable to sleep. The curtains looked like they had not been washed in a very long time and appeared dirty. The washroom was also not properly cleaned, which was unacceptable.

The shower setup seemed poorly fixed, with a hand-held shower that looked newly installed but not properly done. On top of that, the water was only lukewarm instead of hot, making showers uncomfortable. The water pressure kept fluctuating constantly, which was very frustrating.

Another major issue was the electricity in the room, which kept fluctuating as well. Overall, the room felt neglected, unclean, and badly maintained.

The resort has potential because the property itself is nice, but the JADE Room seriously needs urgent upgrades, better cleanliness, and proper maintenance. Guests should be aware that the standard room experience may not match the appearance of the rest of the resort.

To wash down our delectable meal, we opted for the refreshing fruit punch. It was a delightful combination of various fruits, perfectly blended to create a refreshing and thirst-quenching beverage.

Throughout our dining experience, the service at Veg Sagar was impeccable. The staff was courteous, attentive, and went out of their way to ensure that we had a memorable dining experience.

In conclusion, Veg Sagar in Bhayandar West offers a diverse and delicious selection of vegetarian dishes that are sure to satisfy even the most discerning palate. I loved their packing for idli, which comes in a box and given with a banana leaf

I lost my cool when we ordered a starter and it took more that 40 minutes to serve. I don't mind the delay, but the waiter has to atleast tell us that the order will take time to prepare.
It was a very disappointing experience, I am never gonna visit this restaurant again.
